title: Last bit of a nested encoding
statement: Let $x$, $b$, and $t$ be bit strings, with $b$ nonempty. In the encoding of the pair whose first component is the encoding of $(x,b)$ and whose second component is $t$, the bit at position $2 igl(	ext{length of the encoding of }(x,b) igr)-2$, using false as the default for an out-of-range position, equals the last bit of $b$, using true as the default when taking the last bit.
